The Title Vivana

Condominium in Kamala
HomeNew ProjectsThe Title Vivana

Project overview

Four seven-storey residential buildings in Kamala with an Italian coastal style, 306 units in total and a shuttle to Kamala Beach.

Units range from 30 sqm 1-bedroom layouts up to 3-bedroom penthouses. Prices and availability on request via WhatsApp.
